title: DICOM is deterministically converted to a metadata-free raster
description: A generated, non-patient, uncompressed single-frame DX object must cross the input boundary as a deterministic canonical PNG without copied identity tags.

title: Declared burned-in annotation is rejected
description: A generated DX object declaring BurnedInAnnotation=YES must fail closed before any model or case workflow is invoked.

title: Synthetic lung masks localize every detector box deterministically
description: Generated paired lung masks exercise PSPNet output DTO validation, mask QC, left/right and upper/middle/lower two-dimensional lung-field assignment, and explicit outside-lung abstention.

title: Failed lung-mask QC suppresses spatial claims
description: A synthetic failed-QC anatomy record must yield invalid_anatomy without side or lung-field assignments and must remain routing-neutral.

title: Optional contour refinement accounts for every prompt
description: Synthetic MedSAM-shaped evidence must retain every D-FINE prompt index, represent the configured capacity limit as an explicit abstention, render only a transparent contour layer, and reject any routing effect.

title: API presentation removes server paths and emits a transparent lung layer
description: Code-owned API helpers must recursively remove private image artifact references while retaining safe model identity and rendering source-coordinate lung boundaries without embedding the source radiograph.

title: UI rejects anatomy evidence that claims to change routing
description: The real UI client boundary must reject a synthetic API record whose routing_effect is not none, before fetching any presentation layer.

title: Optional refinement failure preserves the lung layer
description: A schema-valid degraded anatomy run must remain completed for lung evidence, preserve identity scope on every UI request, and never fetch a contour layer for the failed optional branch.
